comment: 35yo male, alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency homozygous PiZZ genotype confirmed (serum A1AT 8 µM, <11 µM severe-deficiency threshold; PI*Z/Z by phenotyping). Active current smoker (10 pack-years, 1 ppd since age 20). Early COPD/emphysema on HRCT (panacinar lower-lobe predominant). Mild biochemical hepatic injury (mildly elevated ALT, no cirrhosis yet on FibroScan). No current HCC or lung-cancer diagnosis. PiZZ confers elevated HCC risk in cirrhotic subset (~3-5%/year per Tanash Gastroenterology 2016) and elevated lung-cancer risk in smokers + non-smokers (SIR ~2-3 per Pittelkow JAMA 2014, multiplicatively higher with smoking). DUAL-track urgent prevention: smoking cessation is by far the single highest-impact intervention (PiZZ smokers develop emphysema decades earlier; HCC + lung-cancer synergy). Engine fires RF-A1AT-DEFICIENCY-HCC-LUNG-PREVENTION (any_of: a1at_pizz_genotype_confirmed:true OR a1at_serum_level_severely_deficient:true OR a1at_deficiency_with_cirrhosis:true OR a1at_deficiency_with_copd_emphysema:true) AND RF-LIFESTYLE-TOBACCO-CANCER-PREVENTION (tobacco_status_current_smoker:true) — both fire simultaneously. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = urgent structured smoking cessation (combined behavioural + varenicline / bupropion / NRT) + liver function + AFP q6-12mo + AASLD HCC surveillance if cirrhosis develops + HRCT chest if symptomatic + A1AT augmentation therapy candidacy (Prolastin/Aralast/Zemaira per Chapman Lancet 2015 RAPID); alternative = hepatology/pulmonology observation with imaging on symptom trigger only. Validates v0.3 chronic-condition pilot — dual-track concurrent prevention. Anchored DIS-HCC + DIS-NSCLC + tobacco-RF DIS-NSCLC/SCLC/UROTHELIAL/PDAC/HCC/AML.
